repos_data.description: MCP server for the Live Tennis API. Gives LLM agents in Claude, Cursor and other MCP clients real-time tennis scores, odds and model win-probability.

Unified MCP server — 41 sports API providers, 396 tools in one process: scores, stats, odds, esports, F1/MotoGP/NASCAR, EuroLeague, chess, AFL, boxing & more across 70+ sports. 19 work with no API key.

Free, open-source sports-data MCP server — 841 tools across 64 providers: cross-book betting odds, official league stats, racing, fantasy, cricket, F1 and more. 44 providers need no key. Now also places bets at four Australian books. Claude Desktop / Cursor / any MCP client.
MCP server for OpenFoot API — football fixtures, standings, lineups, live events, shot-level xG and match context for AI agents.
MCP server for the Flash Props API: player props, normalized markets, line movement, and projections across sports and esports, in Claude, Cursor, or any MCP client. Free tier, no scraping.
Official TheRundown data MCP. Six read-only Product API tools, hosted at https://mcp.therundown.io/mcp or run locally over stdio.
